field_principles.status: Records the terminal Exp6543 independent audit state.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Names audit readiness without declaring a scientific result.
field_principles.verdict_class: Separates clean, partial, blocked, and disqualified audit evidence.
field_principles.source_existence_and_hash_receipts: Records artifact, fixture, source, solver, resource, seed, and protected-file hashes.
field_principles.independent_revision_license_and_schema_: Resolves source revision, license, schema, file census, corruption warning, and Z3 path without trusting Exp6542 aggregates.
field_principles.source_identity_audit_rows: Recomputes file, problem, turn, constraint, and source-row hashes from source files.
field_principles.chronology_replay_rows: Rebuilds base-problem turn order and detects gaps, duplicates, or reordering.
field_principles.split_and_lineage_audit: Recomputes train, development, and held lineage sets from fixture rows.
field_principles.independent_exact_replay_rows: Runs fresh Z3 construction for audited rows and compares exact outcomes.
field_principles.shard_and_transaction_audit: Verifies planned units, terminal shards, journal, resume receipts, and final fixture hash.
field_principles.missing_input_disposition: Closes missing or empty-success inputs as blocked with observed values.
field_principles.independent_aggregate_rows: Recomputes aggregate rows locally and compares intake aggregate claims.
field_principles.leakage_attack_matrix: Attacks missing inputs, null rows, duplicates, aggregate tampering, aliases, solver paths, and post-held repair.
field_principles.external_constraint_corpus_audited_ready: Opens only when source, fixture, chronology, split, replay, and transaction checks all pass.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Names failed checks with expected and observed values.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Flattens identity, chronology, replay, aggregate, attack, and gate rows.
field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Recomputes readiness from rows instead of trusting status text.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records date, paths, direct source availability, solvers, resources, seed, and protected hashes.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Shows guarded inputs and conductor files stayed byte-identical during the run.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares independent source, split, transaction, and Z3 replay audit with no LLM inference.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True only for audit checks; the artifact makes no positive scientific class.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why each required field exists.
field_principles.field_provenance: Maps every field to deterministic rows, files, receipts, or tests.
field_principles.random_seed: Pins deterministic replay and attack ordering.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Detects drift in source, fixture, rows, gates, commands, and verdicts.
